text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Developers write unit tests to check small parts of code, such as a single function. Integration tests then verify that different parts work together correctly. Many teams also use test-driven development, where tests are written before the actual code. This approach helps programmers think clearly about what the code should do. Regular testing gives developers confidence because they can change code without fear of breaking something. When tests pass, the team knows the software is working as expected. In short, good testing saves time, reduces bugs, and makes better products.
